nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a compact self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space $H$ over $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$. For every $\varepsilon > 0$ there is a bounded self-adjoint operator $F$ on $H$ with finite-dimensional range such that $\|T - F\| \le \varepsilon$.
nodes.title: Finite-rank approximation of compact self-adjoint operators

nodes.summary: Let $T \neq 0$ be a compact self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space $H$ over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$. Then $T$ has an eigenvalue $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$ with $\mu \neq 0$ and $|\mu| = \|T\|$, where $\|T\|$ is the operator norm of $T$.
nodes.title: A nonzero compact self-adjoint operator has an eigenvalue of modulus equal to its norm

If $Tz \neq 0$ for some $z \in S$, then there are a real number $r$ and a unit vector $v$ with $\langle v, u_i \rangle = 0$ for every…
nodes.title: Next eigenvalue after a finite family of eigenvectors

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a compact self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space $H$ over $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $S$ be a linear subspace of $H$ that admits an orthogonal projection $P : H \to H$ onto $S$ and satisfies $T(S) \subseteq S$, and let $T_1 = PTP$ be the compression of $T$ to $S$. If $T_1 \neq 0$, then there are a real number $r$ and a unit vector $v \in S$ with $Tv = rv$, $|r| = \|T_1\|$ and $|r| \le \|T\|$.

nodes.summary: A nonzero compact self-adjoint operator has a real eigenvalue of modulus equal to its norm, with a unit eigenvector. Let $T \neq 0$ be a compact self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space $H$ over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$. Then there are a real number $r$ and a unit vector $u \in H$ with $T u = r u$ and $|r| = \|T\|$, where $\|T\|$ is the operator norm of $T$.
nodes.title: A nonzero compact self-adjoint operator has a real eigenvalue of modulus equal to its norm, with a unit eigenvector

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a compact self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space over $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$. For every $\varepsilon > 0$, the set of eigenvalues $\mu$ of $T$ with $\varepsilon \le |\mu|$ is finite.
nodes.title: Finiteness of large eigenvalues of a compact self-adjoint operator

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a bounded linear operator on an inner product space over $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$. Every eigenvalue $\mu$ of $T$ satisfies $|\mu| \le \|T\|$.
nodes.title: Eigenvalues are bounded by the operator norm

nodes.summary: Let $H$ be a Hilbert space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$ and let $T : H \to H$ be a compact self-adjoint bounded linear operator. Then the orthogonal complement of the subspace spanned by the eigenspaces $\ker(T - \mu I)$ for all nonzero $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$ equals the kernel of $T$.
nodes.title: Orthogonal complement of the nonzero-eigenvalue eigenspaces
